name: fmp_cik_list
description:
SEC Central Index Keys (CIK) with company names, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/cik-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of records; sent only when given, otherwise FMP's default applies).
Use a CIK with fmp_13f_filing or the edgar_* tools.
Example: {"limit": 50}
